Generated Narrative: CodeSystem eu-ai-clinical-validation-status-cs

This case-sensitive code system http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/eu-ai-clinical-validation-status-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
clinically-validated Clinically ValidatedClinical validation for the documented intended use has been completed.
not-clinically-validated Not Clinically ValidatedClinical validation for the documented intended use has not been completed.
validation-in-progress Validation In ProgressClinical validation is ongoing and no final validation conclusion has yet been documented.
technical-validation-only Technical Validation OnlyTechnical verification or validation has been performed, but clinical validation for the intended use has not been completed.

name: EUAIClinicalValidationStatusCodeSystem
title: EU AI Clinical Validation Status Code System
description: Codes indicating the documented clinical validation status of an AI system for its intended clinical use.
